en.title: Equipping 10,000-Card Domestic Chips with a Super Add-on! Tsinghua Team Aims to Build the Strongest Domestic Token Factory
en.summary: Partnering with Huawei Ascend, a Tsinghua team aims for 100,000 cards in five years.
en.impact: This collaboration could influence domestic chip scaling and token processing capabilities for developers and technology users.

keyPoints: សហការជាមួយ Huawei Ascend

zh-CN.title: 给万卡国产芯装个“超级外挂”！清华团队要造最强国产Token工厂
zh-CN.summary: 清华团队联合华为昇腾，计划在五年内冲刺十万卡目标。
